description: Lists a US restaurant's coming tax, payroll, license and permit deadlines, as the deadline calendar on restaurantdoctorai.com does: federal dates (payroll forms, tip reports, W-2s, 1099s, returns, estimated tax) and the state's (sales tax, unemployment reports, yearly reports, franchise taxes, minimum wage changes, liquor and health permit dates where one date applies to everyone), each moved for weekends and holidays by the agency's rule, with the rule, what a miss costs and the official source. A state date is given only where the state's own page confirms it; the rest come as what to check with the agency. Also the rules for each hire, and a link that opens the same calendar on the website, where the owner adds their own license and permit dates and gets free email reminders. Takes the state and yes/no answers, no names or emails. Reminders, not legal or tax advice. The answers aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calendars is kept.

bigTipped.description: Tipped, and staff worked more than 80 hours in total on a typical day last year, all locations together (Form 8027).

business.description: How the business is set up: sole (sole owner, no LLC), llc_single, llc_multi, partnership (no LLC), s_corp or c_corp. Decides the tax return and the state's yearly report. Left out, both return dates come with an "If".

caterer.description: Mainly catering or a food truck, not a restaurant or bar (OSHA's injury log).

city.description: A city with its own minimum wage, as an id like los-angeles or chicago; left out, the state's rate applies.

contractors.description: Pays a contractor, or rent to a landlord that isn't a corporation, $2,000 or more a year (1099 forms).

deposits.description: Who pays the payroll taxes to the IRS: provider (a payroll company), monthly (the owner, by the 15th), semiweekly (the owner, after each payday).

estimated.description: The owner pays quarterly estimated tax on the business's profit.

formed.description: The month the LLC or corporation was formed with the state, YYYY-MM. Some states set the yearly report by it.

fullTime50.description: 50 or more full-time staff on average, counting part-timers' hours, related businesses together (ACA forms).

months.description: How many months ahead to list, 1 to 15 (default 3). The calendar runs to the end of 2027.

salesTax.description: How often the state has the restaurant file sales tax (on its permit letter or state account).

state.description: The restaurant's US state, two letters (DC for Washington DC).

name: restaurantdoctor_deadlines

calendarUrl.description: The same calendar on restaurantdoctorai.com, where the owner can add the dates printed on their own licenses and permits and get email reminders or a calendar link, free.

checkWith.description: What we can't date for this owner: their own schedule or papers, or a state page not yet confirmed. Never a guessed date.

appliesIf.description: When an answer that decides it wasn't given: the condition it depends on.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, after any weekend or holiday move.

movedFrom.description: The date before a weekend or holiday moved it, and why.

eachHire.description: Rules that run each time the restaurant hires (or something happens), not on a date.

from.description: The first day listed (today in the state), YYYY-MM-DD.

title: List a restaurant's deadlines
